applicationBundle.format: sorted relative path, byte length, and file contents with NUL separators

execution.detail: The command completed every configured measurement trial.

limitations: Windows-only unpackaged Electron measurement; installed packages and Linux/macOS are untested.
The startup input passes ten spare real files and establishes only a settled 100-row floor, not an exact capacity boundary.
The automated overlay/native scrollbar-thumb gesture may be unavailable; programmatic scrollTop is not physical input acceptance.

environment.buildType: production electron-vite build, unpackaged Electron test launch

fixture.contentShape: one H1 plus 40 plain paragraphs; no images, diagrams, math, or remote resources
fixture.openingMethod: isolated Electron profile; CLI receives corpus directory plus every child Markdown path so one real folder-backed window opens all documents

wheel.method: Playwright mouse wheel input over the Opened Files container

scrollbarThumb.method: Playwright pointer drag along the right edge of the Opened Files container
scrollbarThumb.limitation: The automated pointer gesture did not move the overlay/native scrollbar, so this is not an input-acceptance result.

programmaticContainerPositioning.method: set the container scrollTop to its maximum and dispatch a DOM scroll event
programmaticContainerPositioning.limitation: This verifies container scrollability and revision isolation only; it is not equivalent to physical scrollbar input.
